justification: Comparator capability audit revealed that cvss4py evaluates float scores and validates vector syntax but lacks a native vector string serializer and qualitative severity string method. Under literal application of historical precedence (COMPARATOR_UNSUPPORTED_CASE > SCORE_MISMATCH > VECTOR_NORMALIZATION_MISMATCH > EXACT_MATCH), the missing auxiliary serializer would dominate 100% of cases, obscuring the primary scientific endpoint of numeric scoring concordance across the 486,472-vector corpus. Because zero vectors have been executed, this pre-result clarification cleanly separates core numeric concordance from orthogonal diagnostic capabilities.
